description: This business's creative strategy as a decision: the next ad to make and why (the owner's one line), what wins here in plain words (its own ads' results), what tends to win for businesses like it, what rivals lead with, what not to repeat, and a ranked plan of the next 3-5 creatives, each with its id, op (new or variations), format, placements, why, the expected effect and the risk. Useful for 'what should my next ad be?', 'what should we make?'. Read only.

account.description: An ad account's name; omit for the account whose creatives speak for the business (most creative spend).

language.description: The owner line's language. The business's language by default.

name: get_creative_strategy

approvalUrl.description: Where the owner approves it, in Taseli.

tool.description: A ready call with its arguments.

who.description: taseli: Taseli does it or already watches; owner: a tap in Taseli or a fix on the site; agent: the caller may do it.

answer.description: The answer in one line, in the asked language. Every number in it comes from Taseli's code.

asOf.description: The day the data runs to (the daily sync).

why.description: Why, in numbers (days, results, what was left out).

dontDo.description: What not to do now, and why.

error.description: Why nothing was judged, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of a decision (nothing connected yet, not available here).

id.description: The id of this plan item: the strategy_item an ad made from it carries.

reasons.description: At most 3 (6 with detail full), strongest first.

n.description: Peers only: how many businesses the figure comes from.

title: What to make next
